contract.variant: Turkish get-up with a high bridge and leg sweep, bell in the left hand
contract.counting: One full get-up to standing and back down
contract.phases: Lie with the bell pressed; roll to the elbow; post on the hand; high bridge; sweep the leg to a kneel; windshield-wiper the back shin; stand; reverse every step
contract.contacts: Bell-side foot planted until standing; support hand, straight-leg heel and support knee pinned to the floor in their phases; bell arm vertical throughout
